description: On the red bedspread in front of you, there’s a small brown cube-shaped box and a smaller white-and-red carton near it, with a pillow at the head of the bed. The right hand moves left and down to grasp the small carton as a right-hand object, lifts it up and forward over the brown box, then lowers it onto the top surface to stack it neatly; the left hand stays nearby and does not touch anything as the right hand releases.
